## Area of review
Which learning world, Recommendation, question, or screen are you reviewing?

## Current content / concern
Describe the exact passage or behaviour. Do not include personal data, STRs, classified documents or confidential case information.

## Suggested correction
Provide a precise replacement or explanation that separates international principles from national law.

## Supporting public source
Link to an authoritative public standard, official guidance or peer-reviewed academic reference, including its publication / revision date.

## Why the correction matters
Explain how it improves professional accuracy, evidence handling, legal safeguards, learning outcomes or accessibility.

## Reviewer's perspective (optional)
Professional discipline and jurisdiction relevant to the review. Avoid private affiliation details you do not wish to publish.

## Safety and independence acknowledgement
- [ ] This submission contains no confidential operational information or personal data.
- [ ] I understand that proposing a change does not mean my institution endorses AMLVERSE.
